case.summary: Alert HHG-012 was triggered by a legacy real-time risk score of 0.55 on in-person transaction 3553342 ($30.91) on card C05876-K2. Graph investigation revealed the transaction aligns with the cardholder's established pattern, including 849 prior in-person purchases and 21 prior transactions in billing region 494. The calibrated model scored the transaction at 0.008 with a 0.6% historical fraud rate, and the card possesses no fraud ring associations or device anomalies. Additionally, prior closed cases such as CC-0003 on this card were resolved as legitimate. The alert was determined to be a false alarm, and the case was closed with no fraud found.
